title: When a Blood Pressure Survey Changes Its Measurement Protocol
grain: One examined adult with at least two valid systolic readings in each protocol
dataset: NHANES 2017–2018 blood pressure methodology study and demographics
question: How much does replacing a blood-pressure measurement protocol change a survey threshold count?
design: Pair each adult's first three available-position readings (at least two per protocol). Compare the signed differences and both threshold directions using MEC weights and stratified PSU linearization. Fit pooled and partially pooled age-band offsets on other PSUs only.
boundary: The device and examiner change together. Weighted results describe adults with paired examination records; threshold crossings are survey classifications, not new clinical diagnoses.
redistribution: Derived numeric public-use NHANES records; no additional individual identifiers.

fields.age: Years at exam, top-coded by NHANES
fields.psu: Masked primary sampling unit within stratum
fields.minutes: Minutes between protocols; positive means manual first
